 - A primeira geração de Pokémons consistia em 151 criaturas, e em 2025, já estamos na nona geração, com um total de 1025 Pokémons.

# Gráficos

## Correlação gráfico heatmap

```{r heatmap,warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

var_num      <- c("HP", "Attack", "Defense", "Sp..Atk", "Sp..Def", "Speed")
cor_matrix   <- cor(dt[var_num], use = "complete.obs")
paleta       <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))
cor_df       <- melt(cor_matrix, value.name = "correlation")
cor_df_upper <- cor_df %>%
  filter(as.integer(Var1) <= as.integer(Var2))

ggplot(cor_df_upper, aes(x = Var2, y = Var1, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", correlation),
                color = ifelse(abs(correlation) < 0.5, "white", "white")),
            size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = paleta(100),
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.2),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(cor_df$Var1)), position = "left") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "Correlação entre Estatísticas de Pokémon",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#01080f", size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 0, l = 0)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 0)),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.height = unit(2, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 10, b = 10, l = 0),
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines")
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
```

## Correlograma

```{r dispersão, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

dt_sem_name <- dt %>% select(HP, Attack, Defense, Sp..Atk, Sp..Def, Speed)


wine.corr <- cor(dt_sem_name)
ord <- order(wine.corr[1,])
xc <- wine.corr[ord, ord]
plotcorr(xc, col=cm.colors(11)[5*xc + 6])
```

## Relação entre tipo, subtipo e geração

```{r graph,warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
pikomon <- dt %>%
  filter(Type.2 != "")

edges <- pikomon %>%
  filter(!is.na(Type.2)) %>%
  group_by(Type.1, Type.2) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Generation = names(which.max(table(Generation))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 5) %>%
  mutate(
    Grupo = case_when(
      Generation %in% c("1", "2") ~ "1",
      Generation %in% c("3", "4") ~ "2",
      Generation %in% c("5", "6") ~ "3"
    )
  )

graph <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE)

cores_grupos <- c(
  "1" = "#1f77b4",
  "2" = "#32CD32",
  "3" = "#ff7f0e"
)

ggraph(graph, layout = "kk") +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(color = Grupo),
    alpha = 0.7,
    width = 2,
    edge_lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    color = "#5A5A5A",
    size = 8,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name),
    family = "Arial",
    size = 4.5,
    color = "white",
    fontface = "bold",
    repel = TRUE,
    bg.colour = "black",
    bg.r = 0.15,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(
    name = "Geração",
    values = cores_grupos,
    labels = c("1-2", "3-4", "5-6")
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.95, 0.55),
    legend.title = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = "gray80",
      linewidth = 0.3
    )
  )
```

## Lendários e não lendários
```{r scatterplot, echo = FALSE, Warning = FALSE}

main_plot <- dt %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~Defense,
    y = ~Attack,
    color = ~Legendary,
    colors = c("#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e"),
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    symbol    = ~Legendary,
    symbols   = c('circle', 'x'),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    text = ~paste("Name:", Name, "<br>Attack:", Attack, "<br>Defense:", Defense),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

density_x <- dt %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~Defense,
    color = ~Legendary,
    colors = c("#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e"),
    type = "box",
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>%
 layout(
   xaxis = list(
                # showline = FALSE,
                # showticklabels = FALSE,
                showgrid = FALSE,
                zeroline = TRUE),
   yaxis = list(
                # showline = FALSE,
                # showticklabels = FALSE,
                showgrid = FALSE,
                zeroline = TRUE)
 )

density_y <- dt %>%
  plot_ly(
    y = ~Attack,
    color = ~Legendary,
    colors = c("#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e"),
    type = "box",
    showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
  layout(
      xaxis = list(
                   # showline = FALSE,
                   # showticklabels = FALSE,
                   showgrid = FALSE,
                   zeroline = TRUE),
      yaxis = list(
                   # showline = FALSE,
                   # showticklabels = FALSE,
                   showgrid = FALSE,
                   zeroline = TRUE)
    )

final_plot <- subplot(
  density_x,
  plotly_empty(),
  main_plot,
  density_y,
  nrows = 2,
  widths = c(0.85, 0.15),
  heights = c(0.15, 0.85),
  margin = 0.01,
  shareX = TRUE,
  titleX = TRUE,
  shareY = TRUE,
  titleY = TRUE
)

final_plot <- final_plot %>%
  config(responsive = TRUE)

final_plot
```

## Atributos por tipos
```{r prep_spider, echo = FALSE, Warning = FALSE}
tipos_selecionados <- c("Dragon", "Flying", "Steel")
type_colors <- c(
  "Dragon" = rgb(106, 13, 173, max = 255, alpha = 180),
  "Flying" = rgb(135, 206, 235, max = 255, alpha = 180),
  "Steel" = rgb(192, 192, 192, max = 255, alpha = 180)
)
# Por média
dados_tipos_mean <- dt %>%
  filter(Type.1 %in% tipos_selecionados) %>%
  group_by(Type.1) %>%
  summarise(across(c(HP, Attack, Defense, Sp..Atk, Sp..Def, Speed), mean)) %>%
  rename(Type = Type.1)

dados_normalizados_mean <- dados_tipos_mean %>%
  mutate(across(-Type, ~ rescale(.x, to = c(10, 110)))) %>%
  select(-Type) %>%
  as.data.frame()

dados_plot_mean <- rbind(
  rep(120, 6) %>% setNames(names(dados_normalizados_mean)),
  rep(10, 6) %>% setNames(names(dados_normalizados_mean)),
  dados_normalizados_mean
)

# Por mediana
dados_tipos_median <- dt %>%
  filter(Type.1 %in% tipos_selecionados) %>%
  group_by(Type.1) %>%
  summarise(across(c(HP, Attack, Defense, Sp..Atk, Sp..Def, Speed), median)) %>%
  rename(Type = Type.1)

dados_normalizados_median <- dados_tipos_median %>%
  mutate(across(-Type, ~ rescale(.x, to = c(10, 110)))) %>%
  select(-Type) %>%
  as.data.frame()

dados_plot_median <- rbind(
  rep(120, 6) %>% setNames(names(dados_normalizados_median)),
  rep(10, 6) %>% setNames(names(dados_normalizados_median)),
  dados_normalizados_median
)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Por média
```{r spider_mean, echo = FALSE, Warning = FALSE}

radarchart(
  dados_plot_mean,
  axistype = 1,
  pcol = substr(type_colors, 1, 7),
  pfcol = type_colors,
  plwd = 3,
  plty = 1,
  cglcol = "gray50",
  cglty = 1,
  cglwd = 1,
  axislabcol = "gray20",
  vlcex = 1,  # Rótulos aumentados
  # title = "Por média",
  seg = 5,
  centerzero = FALSE,
  cex.main = 1.25)
legend(
  x = "bottomright",
  # inset = c(0, 0),
  legend = c("Dragon", "Flying", "Steel"),
  bty = "n",
  pch = 19,
  col = substr(type_colors, 1, 7),
  text.col = "black",
  cex = 0.8,
  pt.cex = 2,
  y.intersp = 1.3,
  xpd = TRUE)

```
